WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , monthly_paid_buyer_count AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , monthly_paid_order_count AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , monthly_paid_sales_cents AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_paid_summary" monthly_paid_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_10
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_16
ON
  subq_10.metric_time__month = subq_16.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month)

统计范围为青禾当前数据范围内2026年7月、8月两个完整自然月，按全渠道、全门店口径，按CRM会员账户统计月末付费会员相关指标。金额单位为分，订单均额单位为分/单，复购率为小数比例。

| 月份 | 月末付费会员购买人数 | 月末付费会员有效订单数 | 月末付费会员净销售额（分） | 月末付费会员复购人数 | 月末付费会员复购率（小数） | 月末付费会员订单均额（分/单） |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2026年7月 | 6个CRM会员账户 | 6单 | 15500 | 0个CRM会员账户 | 0.0 | 2583.33 |
| 2026年8月 | 6个CRM会员账户 | 10单 | 47550 | 4个CRM会员账户 | 约0.6667 | 4755.00 |

口径说明：月末付费会员购买人数指自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合付费资格的不同账户数；有效订单数指这些账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数；净销售额为上述有效订单的净销售额合计；复购人数指同月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数；复购率按“月内复购会员数 ÷ 同月月内购买会员数”计算；订单均额按“净销售额 ÷ 有效订单数”计算。7月复购人数和复购率为覆盖范围内的零，不是未定义。

本结果按P1暂定口径试算；门店日期规则用于总部月报仍待书面确认。
